name: Preferences
description: A set of company preferences that control application and UI behavior in QuickBooks Online, mostly exposed as read-only with only a small writable subset.

get.note: Read retrieves all preferences for the company; there is no notion of preference objects or object IDs, so no Id is required.

search.note: Query supports sorting and filtering on MetaData timestamp attributes; pagination is not supported.

update.note: Full update of the writable subset; body must include Id and SyncToken. Writable fields omitted from the request body are set to NULL or reverted to a default value.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Required for update. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Required for update. Used to lock an object for use by one app at a time; incremented on each modification. Attempts to modify with an older SyncToken fail. Only the latest version of the object is maintained by QuickBooks Online.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the object. Values are set by Data Services and are read only for all applications.
